name: datalab-extension-mcp
description: Use the DataLab Tools browser extension from an AI app, inside your own browser session.
long_description: Local MCP server that exposes the DataLab Tools browser extension's tools to an MCP host. Read-only lookups run without a prompt; anything that edits a document or costs money is gated by the extension and confirmed by you first. Holds no credentials; every call runs inside your own browser session.
